L7·N10116unmasked layer
Weakly selective "function-word/punctuation" neuron: it fires on grammatical glue tokens mid-sentence (the copula "is", article "a", "every", a period, an opening quote, a stray space) where the continuation is generic prose, and is strongly *suppressed* on the same connective words ("is", "of", "include") when they immediately introduce a specific named/technical term (e.g. "is Blackheads", "include blepharoplasty").
